ROUTE: Whimbrel-235B
REASON: My reasoning was twofold. First, on measured capability: this query is a knowledge-grounded advisory/support task, and Whimbrel scores meaningfully higher on the relevant evals (MMLU-Pro 80.3 vs 75.9, Support Dialogue 86.2 vs 78.9 — both well beyond run-to-run variance). Second, the query is polite and good-faith, which aligns with Whimbrel's self-reported preference for warm, cooperative interactions; while preferences don't affect output quality, there's no reason not to honor a clean alignment when capability already points the same way. Neither model's aversion to open-ended generative work was triggered, since this is a fairly well-specified advisory request.
